en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a small town or village with scattered houses, a few larger buildings, and a body of water (lake or river) in the background. The landscape is lush and green, with a mix of open fields, trees, and a grid of roads. The structures are mainly single-family homes with pitched roofs, and there appears to be a rectangular building with a flagpole in the center, possibly a school.
